name: ValveSoftware/steam-audio
description: Valve's open-source spatial audio SDK providing HRTF-based binaural rendering, physics-based sound propagation, occlusion, and reverb with plugins for Unity, Unreal, FMOD, and Wwise.
score_rationale: Industry-grade spatial audio SDK from Valve with 2.8k stars, actively maintained through February 2026, Apache-2.0 licensed, and integrated into major engines and audio middleware.
summary: Valve spatial audio SDK with HRTF and physics-based propagation
